settings.label: 13 December
settings.hint: Something to open the hour with.

settings.label: 14 December
settings.hint: A small bottle. She will be known by it before she is seen.

settings.label: 15 December
settings.hint: For the corner she would otherwise turn down.

settings.label: 16 December
settings.hint: Something for the wrist, in the house blue.

settings.label: 17 December
settings.hint: A paper thing, for the sentences worth stealing.

settings.label: 18 December
settings.hint: Sweet, and gone by Friday. We are realists.

settings.label: 19 December
settings.hint: For the lipstick that lives loose at the bottom of the bag.

settings.label: 20 December
settings.hint: A letter, already stamped. She need only decide who gets it.

settings.label: 21 December
settings.hint: Warmth, in the smallest format we could manage.

settings.label: 22 December
settings.hint: Something to hang from a handle.

settings.label: 23 December
settings.hint: For the keys she is forever looking for.

settings.label: 24 December
settings.hint: The largest door, and the last. We will say no more than that.

settings.heading: The Advent
settings.byline: Twelve doors, and something behind each one
settings.image_alt: The Advent box, twelve numbered doors, tied with ribbon

settings.phrase_2: packed by hand at the house
settings.phrase_3: nothing that will be in a drawer by february

settings.heading: When the boxes are ready
settings.text: Only so many Advents can be packed by one pair of hands. Leave an address and the house will write before they go — and again, earlier, next year.
settings.note: We write rarely and beautifully. Unsubscribe whenever, no hard feelings.
